headline: Weathered Expanse Flares as Stlican Shelf Quickens
war_summary: Three hours further on, the wires show the centre has shifted to the Weathered Expanse, which posts ten changes in two hours and ninety-eight in the day about Wightwalk, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now three Warden, two Colonial and four neutral, with 7,884 Colonial and 11,253 Warden casualties in the day; Mooring County remains close with four changes in two hours and fifty-two in the day about MacConmara Barrows, the Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, now nine Warden, two Colonial and one neutral, with 7,587 and 8,171 lost. Stlican Shelf has quickened to six changes in two hours and eighteen in the day about Briar and Breaker Town, now one Warden and eight Colonial. Elsewhere Argosa in Godcrofts adds a lone change in two hours. Pari Peak and Palantine Berm, busy earlier, record nothing in the last two hours, while Marban Hollow, Callahan's Passage, the Nevish Line, Gutter and Olavis Wake remain without a change in six hours.
